select PINFO.pbc_code AS pbcProdId, POS.prodid AS prodId, POS.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, SUM(nvl(cabd.TDY_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(cabd.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+nvl(cabd.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) as currencyAmt from PBC_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION POS left join chb_prd_baseinfo info on pos.prodid=info.PROD_ID and info.STATUS in('E','M') inner join (select nvl(t2.pbc_code,a.PBC_PROD_ID) as pbc_code,nvl(inside_prod_id,a.PROD_ID)as prodid from pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub a LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=a.PROD_ID ) PINFO ON PINFO.prodid = POS.prodid left join chb_assets_basis_data cabd on cabd.ASSET_ID =pos.ASSET_CODE and POS.PRODID =cabd.PROD_ID and cabd.STATUS in('E','M') and to_char(cabd.VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{executeDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE POS.ASSET_TYPE1 = 'P06' and POS.AMT>0 and INFO.PROFIT_TYPE= '03' and to_char(pos.ENDDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{executeDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by PINFO.pbc_code,POS.prodid,POS.ASSET_CODE
